orientation_observability.interpretation: A score of 1 is the predeclared minimum directional strength required to interpret an orientation estimate.

primary_design_metric: unweighted macro AURC across informative structure-endpoint-requested-scale strata
informative_stratum_definition: At least one valid and one invalid reference-eligible endpoint case.
selection_rule: Exclude a candidate if its structure-specific macro informative-stratum AURC is more than 0.01 worse than v1_full_max in either CCPs or ER.
Among remaining candidates, choose the lowest pooled macro informative-stratum AURC.
Treat absolute pooled macro AURC differences <= 0.01 as ties and choose the formula with fewer components.
Do not fit continuous weights, endpoint-specific thresholds, or tissue-specific transformations.

excluded_candidate.name: single-image Fourier signal-to-noise ratio
excluded_candidate.reason: High-frequency power is inseparable from sample morphology in a single structural image and could introduce tissue-dependent support decisions.

claim_boundary: Score design may rank measurement support using input-only evidence. High-resolution references are used only to label endpoint error on the score-design partition.
